Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs and Department of Energy and Climate Change, London, August 2011. PB13625.

EMISSION-FACTOR REFERENCE, NOT A TECHNOLOGY SOURCE (belongs with the reference sources, not source-details_sources.csv; the coordinator decides). Methodology paper for the 2011 Defra/DECC company-reporting conversion factors: explains how the Annex 1-10 factors were built. It does NOT print the main Annex 1 direct fuel factors (those are in the separate 2011 conversion-factor spreadsheets); direct factors are the 2009 UK GHG Inventory defaults converted with DUKES 2010 CVs. What it has (in _factors.csv, PRINTED page numbers "Page N of 102" = PDF page): Table 1 indirect fuel-cycle factors (kgCO2e/GJ net CV) for 20 fuels; Tables 4-6 UK grid electricity factors for 2009 (generated, losses, consumed; with and without imports; 5-yr rolling); Table 9 indirect grid factor; Table 53 biofuel life-cycle factors; Table 54 biomass and biogas heating factors. Not loaded: the 1990-2008 years of Tables 3-9, transport (Sects. V-VII), refrigerants (VIII), water and waste (IX, Appendix), overseas electricity (X). No technology data. TRAP: Table 54 prints the unit gCO2e/kWh but the values are kg/kWh.
